title: Chapter 1441
text:
In one of the bases of the Black Star Corps, white lights flashed, and countless army players appeared out of thin air. Very soon, there was a sea of people.

The many veteran players were already familiar with the process. They opened the interface to check the version while opening the quantum network to browse the current time.

"Oh, the time span this time is only a little more than ten years. It's much shorter than last time."

"It's just a small version update. It's alright."

"Didn't the three Universal Civilizations say that the World Tree Civilization will invade our country in more than ten years? The time now should be just right. It seems like the Galaxy Times guessed right. This is the time node of the update, directly entering the stage of the war."

"It's not easy to have a universal war. As long as it's not skipped by a version update, I'll be satisfied."

The players browsed through the events of the past ten years and casually chatted.

During the ten years of preparation for war, there was nothing noteworthy. Only the changes in the Beyond Grade As attracted the interest of many players.

"No way, Lagi is already a Beyond Grade A? I'm so sorry! "

"Hardaway, that gambling dog, hasn't advanced yet? Hahahaha, I knew he wouldn't make it! "

"Ni Ao Tian's life is really smooth. Is this the new generation …"

"F * ck! EsGod has been released, and he even killed a Tree King? Amazing! "

"F * ck, there are too many new Beyond Grade As. The cost of collecting the full set of Wayne Cards has increased again."

"F * ck, has Black Star and the Dragon Emperor made it public? Damn it! There's no hope for me anymore … When you were born, I wasn't born. When I was born, you were already old. Is this the sad life … "

"What are you thinking? Black Star is mine! "

"They're a perfect match. How can a monster like me object? Wuwuwuwu … "

Many army players flipped through the rumors of the Beyond Grade As one after another, and their gossipy hearts burned.

Originally, other than Han Xiao and a few other Beyond Grade As, the other top experts actually did not interact much with the players. The players did not have a deep impression of them, so they would not deliberately remember them. However, the existence of the Wayne Cards became the link that connected the two sides, causing the players to be familiar with the names and deeds of the various Beyond Grade As.

However, compared to casual players, professional players were more focused on utilitarian matters. They weren't in the mood for gossip. Instead, they focused on gathering useful information and discussing it in groups of twos and threes.

Maple Moon analyzed softly. "After this update, there's an additional 'War of All Realms' at the end. The World Tree will most likely be able to fight its way in. This should be the theme of the version."

"Hmm, I checked online. The World Tree has already reached the border, but it's temporarily blocked by the Galactic Alliance Army. Furthermore, the World Tree invaded from the secondary dimension a few days ago and was repelled in the end. The current situation of the three Universal Civilizations is not bad."

Maple Moon looked at the interface and said, "With this minor update, the level cap has been unlocked. This way, the players in the first few echelons should be able to enter the Calamity Grade."

Mad Blade nodded in agreement. "As our overall strength increases, there will be more ways to increase our strength. Moreover, some of our abilities will undergo a qualitative change. I feel that this season's Pro League will undergo a major change."

This time, the small version update did not take too long, and the main storyline quest had not changed. What the pro players were most concerned about was that the level cap had been unlocked from level 180 to level 200. There was more room for improvement.

"Let's go to the frontlines first and let the command center arrange the combat missions."

"Let's go. If we're late, the mission won't be ours."

The players were in an uproar for a while before finally figuring out the current situation. They all boarded their spaceships and headed to the frontlines.

…

On the other side, on the main planet of the Beyond Grade A Association.

Han Xiao had already announced the end of the meeting. When he returned to his room and saw many players coming online through the surveillance, his expression was a little strange.

"Have their levels been unlocked to level 200? As long as they don't have too many subclasses and have a slightly normal growth rate, almost all of them will be able to enter the Calamity Grade. This way, the scale will be large."

If it was in the past, Han Xiao would have been afraid, but now, he had enough confidence. Even if a large number of players entered the Calamity Grade, they would not be able to cause much trouble for him.

Although he had reached the Transcendent Grade, he had not reached his limit yet. He still had to harvest leeks. However, before the last update, he had already harvested a large number of players' assets. Now that the players had just come online, their wallets were dry. He still had to wait for them to earn for a while before he could generate enough income.

Furthermore, Han Xiao had found another way to farm EXP, which was to use psionic waves to kill on the battlefield. This speed was much faster than the mechanical army, and the cost was extremely low and convenient. Even if there was a level penalty, and the ordinary members of the World Tree could only provide the lowest one point of EXP, they could not withstand the power of the psionic waves.

The people of the World Tree kept reviving. They were the perfect targets to farm EXP.

Han Xiao decided that he had to grab hold of both hands and be tough on both sides.

The players were on track, so there was no need to worry too much. What Han Xiao cared more about was the meaning of the version name. He did not have a clue yet.

"No matter what, this is a clue …"

Han Xiao nodded.

Under his influence, the direction of the galaxy was completely different from his previous life. He had also come into contact with many secrets that the players in his previous life could not come into contact with. He did not dare say that he understood this universe completely. Even if his suspicions based on the version name were just groundless accusations, it was still better to be cautious.

Han Xiao closed the interface, summoned Philip, and gave him some instructions. He then changed into the King and teleported to Floating Dragon.

Now that the Blue Star Civilization had migrated, Floating Dragon had followed them and was currently taking refuge in the Central Galaxy.

In the huge Dragon Emperor Palace, a light flashed, and Han Xiao's figure appeared out of thin air. He turned around and walked out, heading all the way to Aesop's residence.

Since there were no clues, he would ask for metaphysics.

He soon arrived at his destination and pressed the doorbell.

"You're here?"

Aesop opened the door and invited Han Xiao in.

Han Xiao did not stand on ceremony and sat down on the sofa. He smiled and said, "Why didn't you predict that I would come to find you this time?"

"Prophecies don't work every time. Ever since you advanced to the Transcendent Grade, my prophecies about you have become more and more difficult …"

Aesop shook his head. "That's true." Han Xiao nodded.He had already done the test. The Information Form projection of the Transcendent Grade had sublimated, as if it had a certain degree of Information Form concealment characteristic. It was very difficult for outsiders to predict him."Why are you looking for me?"Aesop paused and said, "If it's a prophecy, please forgive me for being powerless. I can't use my ability for the time being.""Hmm?What's going on? "Han Xiao was slightly stunned. He looked at Aesop carefully and realized that Aesop's face was dispirited as if he was seriously ill."When I received the passive prophecy, I suffered a backlash. The target of my prophecy was a mage I had never seen before. He inflicted damage on me, and my spirit still needs time to recover. Before that, I can't help you …" Aesop coughed, his tone a little weak."You didn't tell Ames?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows."No, she's too impulsive. If she knew about this, I wonder how she would react."Aesop shook his head. He would rarely reveal important foresight information to Ames and would usually only discuss things with Han Xiao. He continued, "Don't worry."I was going to tell you, but you went to the battlefield while I was hesitating.""When did this happen?" Han Xiao asked."Calculating the time, I triggered the prophecy. It happened to be the eve before the expeditionary army outpost was attacked."Hearing this, Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.What a coincidence … Could it be the Secret Tree King? This guy was indeed a very powerful mage and was very suspicious."Do you have any other memories of that mage?""No, my prophecy image was shattered. I can't remember what he looks like at all.""I see …" Han Xiao pondered and said, "I might have guessed who this person is. He should be an expert from the World Tree.""How is he? Did he cause any danger to you?""Don't worry, I've already sealed him. If you're angry, you're welcome to visit him anytime.""Then forget it. I don't have that kind of bad taste." Aesop waved his hand.Han Xiao smiled, stood up, and was about to leave.At this moment, Aesop suddenly said, "By the way, when are you and Ames going to reproduce?"Han Xiao paused and said helplessly, "How would I know? I can do it anytime, but she doesn't agree. We can only see when she changes her mind.""Heh, she's just being stubborn. As long as the atmosphere is right, everything will be fine."Aesop immediately perked up and said, "Back then, I traveled around the galaxy and made countless females fall in love with me. If it wasn't for my unwillingness, my children would already be all over the Star Fields. Let me tell you, I have a lot of experience in this area. Come, come, come, let me teach you some tricks …""You should keep them for yourself. I don't need them." Han Xiao's eyes twitched."Eh, why don't you need them?These are all spiritual treasures left behind by our predecessors. Once you learn these tricks, convincing Ames will be a piece of cake. I won't teach anyone else … Hey, don't go, at least listen! ""Get lost."Han Xiao did not want to bother with this old scumbag with a rich love history. He changed into the King and teleported away, leaving Aesop sighing in the room with a face full of regret.Holy Covenant Organization base, Destiny's Child laboratory.With a flash of light, Han Xiao teleported over. The surrounding Holy Accord experiment personnel raised their heads to take a look, but they were not surprised and continued with their work.Han Xiao woke up Destiny's Child and communicated with him for a while. He asked Destiny's Child to make a prophecy about his concerns.After a while, Destiny's Child shook his head, indicating that he could not predict anything.Seeing this, Han Xiao knew that the prophecy method was most likely useless. The other party had most likely used some kind of information concealment method."Looks like I can only strengthen the screening and pay attention to any abnormalities …"Han Xiao pondered.…Central Galaxy, desolate universe belt.In a secret base of the Star Alliance, a group of Observers gathered in a large room and stared at the device in the middle of the room.This device was a cylinder with a diameter of about ten meters and a height of about fifteen meters. It was silver-gray in color, and there were many wires connected to its surface. The indicator lights were flashing crazily, and there was a buzzing sound. This was a long-distance material transmission device.After a while, the material transmission device suddenly shook, and the top and bottom separated. The cylinder above slowly rose, and they saw that the inside of the cylinder was hollow. There was a space covered by a transparent cover, and a white suitcase lay quietly inside."My hometown sent the thing over."The captain of the Observers stepped forward and twisted the valve, opening the cover of the material transmission device. He picked up the white suitcase and opened it on the spot. There were three white cans in the suitcase without any labels.He took a pistol-like device from one of the team members and scanned the three cans one by one. After looking at the readings, he nodded."Confirmed. They are all microscopically encoded particles."As soon as he said that, everyone present was overjoyed.The Star Alliance had ordered the Observer team to secretly leak information about the three Universal Civilizations. They had thought of many ways, including using the energy of the supernova explosion to transmit wave-like information to the entire universe and using the star position communication method to secretly transmit information to the World Tree, but they were all rejected.In the end, the Star Alliance chose to encode the tiny particles. Using the microscopic transcription technology, they unfolded the particles in a low dimension and recorded a huge amount of information. Then, they returned to their original form, turning the extremely tiny particles into information carriers that contained all the information they wanted to leak.The Star Alliance had created a bunch of encoded particles in batches and was prepared to throw these encoded particles outside the border through the wormhole, causing the storage device to self-destruct at a fixed time and attract the attention of the World Tree. At the same time, they would spread the particles.They believed that with the technology of the World Tree, they should be able to discover the abnormalities of these encoded particles and intercept them.The Star Alliance had developed for a long time, and they had very high technological capabilities. They also dabbled in information forms and had always provided information concealment for the Observer team. They were not afraid of their actions being discovered by prophecies. They had secretly stolen the technological achievements of the galactic society for many years and knew the galactic society like the back of their hands. They were confident that they would not be discovered. "That's true." Han Xiao nodded.

He had already done the test. The Information Form projection of the Transcendent Grade had sublimated, as if it had a certain degree of Information Form concealment characteristic. It was very difficult for outsiders to predict him.

"Why are you looking for me?" Aesop paused and said, "If it's a prophecy, please forgive me for being powerless. I can't use my ability for the time being."

"Hmm? What's going on? "

Han Xiao was slightly stunned. He looked at Aesop carefully and realized that Aesop's face was dispirited as if he was seriously ill.

"When I received the passive prophecy, I suffered a backlash. The target of my prophecy was a mage I had never seen before. He inflicted damage on me, and my spirit still needs time to recover. Before that, I can't help you …" Aesop coughed, his tone a little weak.

"You didn't tell Ames?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

"No, she's too impulsive. If she knew about this, I wonder how she would react."

Aesop shook his head. He would rarely reveal important foresight information to Ames and would usually only discuss things with Han Xiao. He continued, "Don't worry.

"I was going to tell you, but you went to the battlefield while I was hesitating."

"When did this happen?" Han Xiao asked.

"Calculating the time, I triggered the prophecy. It happened to be the eve before the expeditionary army outpost was attacked."

Hearing this, Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

What a coincidence … Could it be the Secret Tree King? This guy was indeed a very powerful mage and was very suspicious.

"Do you have any other memories of that mage?"

"No, my prophecy image was shattered. I can't remember what he looks like at all."

"I see …" Han Xiao pondered and said, "I might have guessed who this person is. He should be an expert from the World Tree."

"How is he? Did he cause any danger to you?"

"Don't worry, I've already sealed him. If you're angry, you're welcome to visit him anytime."

"Then forget it. I don't have that kind of bad taste." Aesop waved his hand.

Han Xiao smiled, stood up, and was about to leave.

At this moment, Aesop suddenly said, "By the way, when are you and Ames going to reproduce?"

Han Xiao paused and said helplessly, "How would I know? I can do it anytime, but she doesn't agree. We can only see when she changes her mind."

"Heh, she's just being stubborn. As long as the atmosphere is right, everything will be fine." Aesop immediately perked up and said, "Back then, I traveled around the galaxy and made countless females fall in love with me. If it wasn't for my unwillingness, my children would already be all over the Star Fields. Let me tell you, I have a lot of experience in this area. Come, come, come, let me teach you some tricks …"

"You should keep them for yourself. I don't need them." Han Xiao's eyes twitched.

"Eh, why don't you need them? These are all spiritual treasures left behind by our predecessors. Once you learn these tricks, convincing Ames will be a piece of cake. I won't teach anyone else … Hey, don't go, at least listen! "

"Get lost."

Han Xiao did not want to bother with this old scumbag with a rich love history. He changed into the King and teleported away, leaving Aesop sighing in the room with a face full of regret.

Holy Covenant Organization base, Destiny's Child laboratory.

With a flash of light, Han Xiao teleported over. The surrounding Holy Accord experiment personnel raised their heads to take a look, but they were not surprised and continued with their work.

Han Xiao woke up Destiny's Child and communicated with him for a while. He asked Destiny's Child to make a prophecy about his concerns.

After a while, Destiny's Child shook his head, indicating that he could not predict anything.

Seeing this, Han Xiao knew that the prophecy method was most likely useless. The other party had most likely used some kind of information concealment method.

"Looks like I can only strengthen the screening and pay attention to any abnormalities …"

Han Xiao pondered.

…

Central Galaxy, desolate universe belt.

In a secret base of the Star Alliance, a group of Observers gathered in a large room and stared at the device in the middle of the room.

This device was a cylinder with a diameter of about ten meters and a height of about fifteen meters. It was silver-gray in color, and there were many wires connected to its surface. The indicator lights were flashing crazily, and there was a buzzing sound. This was a long-distance material transmission device.

After a while, the material transmission device suddenly shook, and the top and bottom separated. The cylinder above slowly rose, and they saw that the inside of the cylinder was hollow. There was a space covered by a transparent cover, and a white suitcase lay quietly inside.

"My hometown sent the thing over."

The captain of the Observers stepped forward and twisted the valve, opening the cover of the material transmission device. He picked up the white suitcase and opened it on the spot. There were three white cans in the suitcase without any labels.

He took a pistol-like device from one of the team members and scanned the three cans one by one. After looking at the readings, he nodded.

"Confirmed. They are all microscopically encoded particles."

As soon as he said that, everyone present was overjoyed.

The Star Alliance had ordered the Observer team to secretly leak information about the three Universal Civilizations. They had thought of many ways, including using the energy of the supernova explosion to transmit wave-like information to the entire universe and using the star position communication method to secretly transmit information to the World Tree, but they were all rejected.

In the end, the Star Alliance chose to encode the tiny particles. Using the microscopic transcription technology, they unfolded the particles in a low dimension and recorded a huge amount of information. Then, they returned to their original form, turning the extremely tiny particles into information carriers that contained all the information they wanted to leak.

The Star Alliance had created a bunch of encoded particles in batches and was prepared to throw these encoded particles outside the border through the wormhole, causing the storage device to self-destruct at a fixed time and attract the attention of the World Tree. At the same time, they would spread the particles.

They believed that with the technology of the World Tree, they should be able to discover the abnormalities of these encoded particles and intercept them.

The Star Alliance had developed for a long time, and they had very high technological capabilities. They also dabbled in information forms and had always provided information concealment for the Observer team. They were not afraid of their actions being discovered by prophecies. They had secretly stolen the technological achievements of the galactic society for many years and knew the galactic society like the back of their hands. They were confident that they would not be discovered.
